pathAssumptions.schedule: Path linear between O/H/L/C at 0/5/10/15 minutes. Actual scans at M15 boundaries plus 60s in dynamic cases; static early candle HOLD cases compressed. Source quote protection precedes 10s app management.
limitations: M15 retained OHLC does not identify exact intrabar ordering/timing; two paths are sensitivity witnesses, not exhaustive bounds.
Synthetic constant pair spreads derive all bid/ask candle features and quotes coherently from midpoint; this changes historical side anchors and is an explicit alternative price world.
Native component path pairs independent side extrema synchronously by assumption; actual simultaneous spread/liquidity unknown.
Static 5% margin and whole-unit model; no latency/real broker homeConversion parity.
No financing events supplied; no exact total historical cost claim.
No forced end close, annual cash reset, episode reset, risk-gate override, optimization or untouched holdout.

financing.disclosure: No historical financing charges supplied. Session close precedes usual rollover; any residual rollover or fee is unresolved.

uncertainty.limitations: Conditional sensitivity assuming exchangeable trade-bearing days; ignores interday dependence, parameter selection and unobserved paths/costs. Not an independent live-edge confidence claim.

scanSummary.retentionPolicy: All decisions/trades/intents/broker state retained. Consumed signal trace rows periodically removed after aggregate capture; analytics signal counts are not used.

accounting.scope: Supplied model points and explicitly recorded costs; no intrabar or historical financing claim.
